description: Defines the class WriteResultAndErrors, a data structure for encapsulating write models, results, and errors related to MongoDB bulk write operations within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: WriteResultAndErrors
classes.description: Immutable class representing the outcome of a bulk write operation, including success, failure, or unexpected error states.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates an instance representing a successful bulk write with no errors.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Creates an instance representing a failed bulk write due to a MongoBulkWriteException.

methods.name: unexpectedError
methods.description: Creates an instance representing an unexpected error during the write operation.

methods.name: getWriteModels
methods.description: Returns the list of write models requested.

methods.name: getBulkWriteResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the bulk write operation.

methods.name: getBulkWriteErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors encountered during the bulk write.

methods.name: getUnexpectedError
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the unexpected error if any occurred.
